_comment: AI Settings, native emtk window. The three collapsible panels, the Test / Save / Reset row and the result line of the Qt tool (ai_settings.view.json), drawn by emtk.view_form over AISettingsModel (gui/model.py). The Qt text/image model boxes are editable combos; emtk's choice is not, so each model is a text field (any id) plus a pick list of the fetched ids. The eye toggle of the Qt key field is the 'Show key' check box: two fields on the same attribute, one masked and one in clear text. 'settings' is the scrolling form, 'actions' the Test / Save / Reset bar and the result line, each a window of gui/app.py.
title: AI Settings

sections.name: settings
sections.title: AI Settings
sections.description: The provider, its models and the generation settings.

sections.text: Configure one endpoint per provider, with separate models for chat/code tasks and image generation.
sections.description: What this window is for.

sections.title: API Configuration
sections.description: Which provider to use, where its API lives and the key that unlocks it.

sections.label: Provider
sections.description: Which AI provider to use. The list comes from the provider table in chisurf.core.settings.ai_settings, so it always matches what the rest of the app supports. Each provider keeps its own base URL, key and models.

buttons.label: Sign in via browser
buttons.description: Open the provider's console to create or copy an API key.

sections.label: Base URL
sections.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL for the selected provider.

sections.label: API Key
sections.placeholder: Paste API key - it is saved and tested automatically
sections.description: Bearer token for the endpoint, drawn as stars. Pasting a key (Enter, or a click elsewhere) auto-saves it and tests the connection. Not needed for most local servers.

sections.label: API Key
sections.placeholder: Paste API key - it is saved and tested automatically
sections.description: Bearer token for the endpoint, shown in clear text because Show key is on. Pasting a key (Enter, or a click elsewhere) auto-saves it and tests the connection.

sections.label: Show key
sections.description: Show the API key in clear text instead of stars. For this session only: a provider switch hides it again, and the setting is never saved.

sections.label: ACP command
sections.description: Executable and arguments of the stdio ACP agent; quoted paths are supported.

sections.label: In-tree server API
sections.description: HTTP provider the in-tree ACP server uses; an external agent manages its own provider.

sections.title: Models
sections.description: The model used for text (chat, code) and the one used for images.

sections.label: Text model
sections.description: Used for chat, code editing, explanations, and other text tasks. Type any model id, or pick one of the fetched models below.

sections.label: Image model
sections.description: Used only for plugin icon and other image-generation tasks. Type any model id, or pick one of the fetched models below.

sections.label: Fetched text models
sections.description: The text-capable models the endpoint listed. Picking one sets the text model.

sections.label: Fetched image models
sections.description: The image-capable models the endpoint listed. Picking one sets the image model.

buttons.label: Fetch models
buttons.description: Query the endpoint's /models list and split it into text and image models. Runs in the background.

sections.title: Generation Settings
sections.description: Sampling settings sent with every request. The defaults are sensible.

sections.label: Temperature
sections.description: Sampling temperature (0 = deterministic, higher = more random).

sections.label: Top-p
sections.description: Nucleus-sampling probability mass.

sections.label: Max tokens
sections.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate per response.

sections.name: actions
sections.title: Test / Save / Reset
sections.description: Check the endpoint, save the settings, or reset them; the result is shown below the buttons.

buttons.label: Test connection
buttons.description: Check the endpoint responds to a /models request. Runs in the background.

buttons.label: Save
buttons.description: Persist the current provider's settings to ai_api_settings.json in the settings folder.

buttons.label: Reset
buttons.description: Reset the current provider's fields to defaults (not saved until you press Save).

sections.description: The result of the last Fetch models, Test connection, Save or Reset.
